data.title: Update dependency command to allow for primary and secondary dependencies
data.description:
The dependency command should have an additional `--add` flag. If not included, this would entirely replace the parent of the child that is being modified. If `--add` is included, this would append the parent ID such that the child issue can have multiple parents.

The first parent issue in the list of parent issues is the 'primary' parent. It should be the one that is displayed in the graph when the `fleece list {--next|--tree}` command is run. Add a `--primary` flag to the dependency command such that if passed in the dependency that is being defined becomes the primary dependency.
